# Local Weather Dashboard

> A single-page dashboard showing current weather conditions and a 7-day forecast for
> Aarhus, Denmark, built with Vite + React + Tailwind and Open-Meteo (no API key required).

This is a take-home coding assessment project. The site is a client-side-only SPA — there
are no other crawlable routes, no backend API surface for agents to call, and no user
accounts or data to protect.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/fred321f/FrederickXBetterDevelopers/blob/main/localweatherdashboard/README.md): setup, run instructions, dev log, and architecture decisions
- [Source repository](https://github.com/fred321f/FrederickXBetterDevelopers/tree/main/localweatherdashboard): full source, Vite + React + TypeScript + Tailwind v4 + shadcn

## Notes for agents

- Weather data comes live from [Open-Meteo](https://open-meteo.com/) at request time; there is no
  static snapshot to read instead of rendering the page.
- The page requires JavaScript — content is client-rendered, so a plain HTTP fetch of `/` will
  return an empty shell rather than the dashboard content.
- No login, no forms that submit data, no destructive actions anywhere on this site.
